purpose: Test whether FAR-style future-blind relevance can preserve predictive evidence when past observations must actually be discarded
first_minimal_change: Replace the original external outbound archive with an online fixed-capacity memory, keeping official data/model/target path/renderer metrics unchanged
deletion_information_boundary: Only arrived observations and current query/action; never the return route, future image, semantic target, or retrieval scores queried from the future
phase1_frozen_IJEPA_feature_prediction_e: Separate subsequent protocol; do not pretend FAR tokenizer or scorer weights are an IJEPA reproduction
preconditions: actual FAR reproduction and cost results
algorithm input/output source audit and implementation before inference
exact numeric binding and all retained/deleted frame IDs
new prospective source/protocol lock and full budget
no adaptive choice of clips/horizons/thresholds from heldout scores
